components.name: Pill Control
components.description: Hairline pill for buttons, tabs and language switch; the selected one inverts.
components.css: .ds-pill { background: transparent; border: 1px solid #232c3a; border-radius: 999px; color: #c4ccd9; min-height: 32px; padding: 6px 16px; line-height: 1.2; font: inherit; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.14s ease, color 0.14s ease; } .ds-pill:hover { background: #161d28; border-color: #8d97ab; color: #f2f5fa; } .ds-pill:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #7aa2ff; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-pill-active { background: #f2f5fa; border-color: #f2f5fa; color: #07090d; font-weight: 600; }

components.name: Apply Button
components.description: The one filled colour in the skin.
components.css: .ds-apply { background: #7aa2ff; border: 1px solid #7aa2ff; border-radius: 999px; color: #06080c; font-weight: 600; min-height: 32px; padding: 6px 16px; font: inherit; font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer; } .ds-apply:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #7aa2ff; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Sidebar Nav Item
components.description: Transparent 8px item; active adds raised fill, seam and an accent dot.
components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 4px; width: 200px; } .ds-nav-item { background: transparent; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 8px; color: #c4ccd9; padding: 8px 12px; text-align: start; font: inherit; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.14s ease, color 0.14s ease; } .ds-nav-item:hover { background: #161d28; color: #f2f5fa; } .ds-nav-item:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #7aa2ff; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-nav-active { background: #161d28; border-color: #232c3a; color: #f2f5fa; font-weight: 600; } .ds-nav-active::before { content: ''; display: inline-block; width: 6px; height: 6px; border-radius: 50%; background: #7aa2ff; margin-inline-end: 8px; vertical-align: middle; }

components.name: Field
components.description: Inset fill, strong seam, no shadow.
components.css: .ds-field { background: #0a0e14; border: 1px solid #232c3a; border-radius: 8px; color: #f2f5fa; padding: 8px 12px; font: inherit; } .ds-field:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #7aa2ff; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.css: .ds-panel { --accent: #7aa2ff; background-color: #0e131b; background-image: linear-gradient(180deg, color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 15%, transparent) 0, transparent 72px); border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.07); border-top: 2px solid var(--accent); border-radius: 18px; padding: 16px 20px 14px; color: #f2f5fa; width: 340px; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-title { font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: 0.14em; text-transform: uppercase; color: #8d97ab; margin-bottom: 10px; } .ds-kpis { display: flex; border-top: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.07); border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.07); } .ds-kpi { flex: 1; padding: 12px 14px 10px; text-align: start; } .ds-kpi + .ds-kpi { border-inline-start: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.07); } .ds-kpi b { display: block; font-size: 1.7rem; font-weight: 400; line-height: 1.1; letter-spacing: -0.02em; } .ds-cash { color: var(--accent); } .ds-kpi span { font-size: 0.68rem; letter-spacing: 0.12em; text-transform: uppercase; color: #8d97ab; } .ds-track { height: 10px; background: #161d28; border-radius: 5px; margin-top: 14px; } .ds-fill { width: 60%; height: 100%; background: #5fd38d; border-radius: 5px; }

narrative.overview: Glass is one opt-in look of a multi-skin product; Classic is the default and the base Glass is layered on. Glass changes the surface, not the structure: smoked-glass panels on a near-black ground, divided by 1px seams, each Oversight panel lit along its top edge by one thin line of its company's colour. Hairlines and light do the dividing; nothing is blurred, shadowed or heavily filled. Rank comes from weight, case and size, not extra colours. The light scheme keeps the same structure on pale grey with white panels.
keyCharacteristics: One skin among four; Classic stays default and is the base Glass is layered on.
Seams over fills: 1px hairlines everywhere, no blur, no panel shadow.
One coloured edge light per company panel; company colour is the only colour that ranks.
Light-weight large figures with tabular numerals; small spaced uppercase labels.
Pill-shaped hairline controls; the selected one inverts to text-on-background.
Dark first, with a real light scheme; both flip right-to-left without separate rules.

rules.name: The One Edge Rule
rules.body: A panel carries a single colour: its company's top-edge line (2px, fading down over about 72px at 15% dark, 7% light). Do not add a second tint, border colour or fill to it.

rules.name: The Seam Rule
rules.body: Division is a 1px hairline. If two things need separating, use a seam or space, never a shadow, blur or heavier fill.

rules.name: The Light Numerals Rule
rules.body: Big figures and the page title are light or regular weight; weight 600 is for selection and totals only.

rules.name: The Text Glyph Rule
rules.body: Existing emoji in titles and nav are rendered as text glyphs where the browser supports it. They are carried-over markup, not part of the skin's language.

rules.name: The No-Blur Rule
rules.body: Glass is a name for the look, not a technique. Header and sidebar are opaque and the skin turns Classic's blur off.

dos: Do treat Glass as one skin: scope every rule to the Glass skin attribute and leave Classic and the other skins unchanged.
Do drive colour through the theme tokens so dark, light and right-to-left follow without extra rules.
Do use the company colour for the edge light, company dot and cash figure, and nowhere else on that panel.
Do use inline-start/end properties and logical margins for anything directional.
Do keep numerals tabular and large figures light.
donts: Don't add shadows, blur or heavy fills to panels, header or sidebar.
Don't put a box inside a panel; a table or KPI row inside a panel is hairlines only.
Don't introduce a second accent or per-element tints to rank things; use weight, case and size.
Don't describe Glass as the app's brand or let it change content, markup, class names or behaviour.
